The College Navigators | Virtual College Counseling on Instagram: "Miami University is a mid-sized public college located in Oxford, Ohio, about 35 miles from Cincinnati. 

Home to around 17,000 undergraduates, it’s known for its strong focus on undergraduate teaching, a classic red-brick campus, and a mix of liberal arts and professional programs with standout business and education schools. 

The first-year freshman class enrollment is typically around 4,500 students.

Miami offers a traditional college town vibe that’s close-knit, spirited, and community-driven.

💰 FUN FACT: Miami’s Tuition Promise locks in tuition and fees for four years for each incoming class. In addition to being an affordable option, Miami also offers merit scholarships to both in-state and out-of-state students.

⭐️ Farmer School of Business

3.7-4.22 mid-50% GPA
26-31 mid-50% ACT
1240-1380 mid-50% SAT

⭐️ Nursing

4.0-4.38 mid-50% GPA
26-30 mid-50% ACT
1230-1360 mid-50% SAT

48.5% Ohio Admits
51.5% from 50 states, DC & 119 countries

🎯 If you enjoyed learning about a college that offers a solid education, is affordable, and not overly competitive, you will love The Navigator Network.

In every live webinar, I spotlight two schools—one public and one private—that are affordable, offer strong merit scholarships, and are typically great target options for many students.

It is a fun and easy way to discover great colleges to consider adding to your list!

🔥 Comment Network for more info about joining! 

💫 Follow @thecollegenavigators for tips and advice for college admissions planning! 

#collegeadmissions #miamiu #ohiocolleges #classof2029 #classof2025"
